spanish: Y día el séptimo shabat a Jehová tu Dios; no harás toda obra, tú y tu hijo y tu hija, tu siervo y tu sierva y tu bestia y tu peregrino que en tus puertas.

findings.issue: שַׁבָּת is a common noun (H7676), left as the untranslated form shabat; common nouns stay Spanish.
no harás toda obra can be read as a partial ban (not every work); לֹא plus כָל licenses an exhaustive ban on the work.
peregrino in current Spanish often means pilgrim, a narrower role than the sojourner noun גֵּר.

notes: Other tokens match in conjunctions, person, number, and the verbless clauses.
